## Objective

What should be completed?

## Primary owner

## Deliverable

List the exact files, figures, tables, code, or notes required.

## Dependencies

What must be available first? Which tasks depend on this work?

## Definition of done

- [ ] Code or research output exists.
- [ ] A small verification example or test exists.
- [ ] Assumptions and limitations are documented.
- [ ] Handover notes are complete.
- [ ] A pull request is opened and reviewed.

## AI-use boundary

What requires the student's own judgement? What may AI help with? Do not ask AI to invent results, citations, or dataset facts.

## Blockers

Tag the team leader when a blocker prevents progress for more than one working session.
